statement: A priority-recovery follow-up count-neutral REPLACE reaches operation creation when the authoritative SERVICES owner is transiently unavailable only under a typed recovery-cure contract: the priority-recovery owner declares the relocation cure, the actual cache contains the named live voter source, authoritative operation visibility is usable with no conflicting in-flight operation, the target node is vacant, and replica inventory has no anomaly. Generic ADDs, ordinary REPLACEs, unavailable operation visibility, missing or non-live sources, occupied targets, and anomalous inventories remain fail-closed. This closes the fresh managed-merge live first invariant where the owner reported needs_operation/create_recovery_operation but priority control-plane REPLACEs were repeatedly rejected as replica_inventory_unusable. Prove the real planner-to-coordinator seam red on current head and green on the fix for three consecutive deterministic runs, without timeout increases, ledger-interlock weakening, managed-merge changes, or cache-as-authority fallback.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Use the retained fresh five-node managed-merge run as attribution evidence only: the analyzer named rebalancer_leader/operation_scheduling/needs_operation/create_recovery_operation and the full logs showed the attempted priority REPLACEs rejected as replica_inventory_unusable. Discovery and proof remain deterministic; do not iterate the live harness to discover the fix.

Any owner-unavailable exception must be carried from the priority-recovery cure owner through the real move-execution boundary and revalidated at coordinator admission against a named actual source, vacant target, usable authoritative operation visibility, and anomaly-free inventory. Partition class or REPLACE type alone is insufficient.

Preserve fail-closed behavior for generic ADD, ordinary REPLACE, unavailable or deferred operation visibility, missing/non-voter/non-live source, occupied target, and anomalous inventory. Do not broaden the existing concentrated-ledger exception, weaken the operation-ledger interlock, raise a timeout/budget, or change managed-partition-merge source.
